shared_elements: repeated row of similar figures aligned along a baseline
raised relief against a flat cut-back ground
justification: Both are stone low reliefs in which profile figures are set in horizontal rows against a flattened ground, and both use repeated similar heads/creatures in a band, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a rough, shallow, schematic pillar with animals and abstract signs scattered over irregular zones, whereas B is a smooth, finely modelled, evenly spaced procession of clothed human figures carrying vessels, with careful anatomical and textile detail.
